record.question: When WBC's are counted manually by Turks fluid, blood is diluted by ratio:
record.explanation: Answer A: 1:20. The conventional manual total WBC count with a WBC pipette uses a 1:20 blood dilution in Türk fluid. Reference: https://giwmscdntwo.gov.np/media/pdf_upload/hematology%20SOP_4ffyqhz.pdf; https://www.jru.edu.in/studentcorner/lab-manual/bpharm/1st-sem/HumanAnatomy.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
